title: Landing Page & Booking Management System
description: Internal web application for the Project Resolution Management division featuring company profile, meeting room booking, and role-based administration.
longDescription:
PRM Telkom is an internal web application developed during my MBKM internship at PT Telkom Indonesia for the Project Resolution Management division. The system was created to support internal operational activities by centralizing company information and simplifying meeting room reservations across divisions.

I independently designed the system architecture, developed the full-stack application covering frontend implementation, backend development, authentication, role-based access control, database design, and production deployment.
problem: The Project Resolution Management division required an internal platform to centralize company information and simplify meeting room reservation processes while maintaining role-based access and administrative control.
solution: Designed and developed a web-based internal application that integrates company profile management, authentication, user authorization, and meeting room booking into a single platform using Next.js, PHP, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and MySQL.
responsibilities: Frontend Development with Next.js and TypeScript
Backend Development with PHP and MySQL
features: Role-based access control for admin and user roles
Meeting room reservation with conflict prevention
User management and access control panel
challenges: Implementing synchronized meeting room reservations while preventing booking conflicts and maintaining data consistency between concurrent users.
Designing a scalable role-based authentication and authorization system that supports multiple user levels with different access permissions.
Building reusable UI components for internal administration interfaces that maintain consistency across different modules.
lessonsLearned: Strengthened understanding of enterprise application development and internal business system requirements.
Improved knowledge of authentication and authorization patterns for multi-role web applications.
Learned scalable relational database design for production environments.
Experienced end-to-end software development lifecycle independently, from requirements analysis to deployment.

title: Internship Management System
description: Web-based internship management system for DAOP V Purwokerto to manage intern data from registration through active periods to final report archival.
longDescription:
Developed during my internship at PT Kereta Api Indonesia DAOP V Purwokerto, this web application digitalizes the internship administration process by centralizing participant data management, internship status tracking, and report archival into a single platform.

The system enables administrators to efficiently manage the complete internship lifecycle — from initial registration, active internship monitoring, to final report submission and archival. Built using Laravel Filament as the admin panel framework and MySQL for data persistence, the application covers database design, feature implementation, system testing, and user interface development.
problem: Internship participant administration at DAOP V Purwokerto was previously managed through manual processes, making data tracking, status monitoring, report management, and participant record-keeping inefficient and prone to errors.
solution: Designed and developed a centralized web application using Laravel Filament that streamlines internship data management from registration through active periods to final report archival, reducing manual administrative workload and improving data accessibility.
responsibilities: Admin Panel Development with Laravel Filament
features: Internship participant registration and data management
Internship status tracking across lifecycle stages
Final report submission and archival system
challenges: Designing a database structure capable of handling the complete internship lifecycle data while maintaining data consistency across registration, active periods, and archival stages.
Building an intuitive admin interface using Laravel Filament that non-technical staff could operate efficiently.
lessonsLearned: Strengthened full-stack development skills using the Laravel ecosystem.
Improved relational database design for lifecycle-based data management.
Learned practical system requirement analysis during enterprise software development.
Gained experience building internal administrative information systems for real organizational needs.

title: Si Pak-E
description: Web-based expert system for diagnosing BMW E36 engine & undercarriage problems using the Certainty Factor method, processing user-reported symptoms to generate diagnostic results with calculated confidence levels.
longDescription:
Si Pak-E is a web-based expert system developed to help BMW E36 owners identify engine power loss and undercarriage problems without requiring extensive mechanical knowledge.

The system performs diagnosis by processing user-selected symptoms through the Certainty Factor inference method. Users provide their confidence level for each symptom they experience, and the system calculates the certainty of each possible diagnosis by combining individual symptom certainty values using the Certainty Factor combination formula. This approach was chosen because it effectively handles uncertainty in user-reported data while providing measurable confidence scores for each diagnosis result.

The application consists of a Next.js frontend and a PHP backend connected through REST APIs. It also provides an administrative dashboard for managing the knowledge base, symptoms, diagnostic rules, and user data, making the system maintainable and scalable.
problem: BMW E36 owners often experience difficulties identifying the root cause of mechanical problems due to limited technical knowledge and the lack of accessible diagnostic tools that can process uncertain symptom information.
solution: Developed a rule-based expert system using the Certainty Factor method that processes user-reported symptoms with individual confidence levels, evaluates diagnostic rules from the knowledge base, and generates possible causes along with calculated certainty percentages and recommended solutions.
responsibilities: System Analysis and Knowledge Base Design
Frontend Development with Next.js and TypeScript
Backend REST API Development with PHP
features: Interactive symptom-based diagnosis with confidence input
Certainty Factor calculation with percentage-based results
Knowledge base management for expert rules and symptoms
Symptom and diagnostic rule CRUD management
Secure authentication with role-based access control
challenges: Designing a flexible Certainty Factor inference mechanism capable of handling multiple symptom combinations with varying confidence levels while producing accurate diagnostic results.
Maintaining consistency between frontend diagnosis flows and backend inference logic through REST API communication.
Structuring the knowledge base to support easy maintenance and expansion of diagnostic rules by domain experts.
lessonsLearned: Strengthened understanding of expert system architecture, rule-based reasoning, and the Certainty Factor inference method.
Improved full-stack development skills using Next.js and PHP with REST API integration.
Learned to design scalable relational database structures for knowledge-based systems.
Enhanced experience integrating complex business logic between frontend and backend services.

title: Landing Page Smartani
description: Responsive landing page for the Smartani IoT agriculture platform, built with React and Tailwind CSS using component-based architecture and mobile-first responsive design.
longDescription:
Smartani is a responsive landing page developed for the Smartani IoT Farmer organization to establish a professional web presence for their smart agriculture platform. The website communicates the platform's products, services, features, and vision through a clean, modern interface optimized for all devices.

The front end was built using React with a component-based architecture, styled with Tailwind CSS. Development focused on creating reusable UI components, maintaining a clear information hierarchy, implementing smooth scroll navigation, and ensuring consistent responsive layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
problem: The Smartani IoT Farmer organization needed a professional web presence to clearly communicate its products, services, and value proposition to potential users, partners, and stakeholders.
solution: Built a responsive, component-based landing page using React and Tailwind CSS with modular sections, consistent visual hierarchy, interactive elements, and optimized navigation flow across all device sizes.
responsibilities: Responsive Web Development with Mobile-first Approach
features: Fully responsive layout across all breakpoints
FAQ section with expandable accordion items
challenges: Maintaining consistent layout and visual hierarchy across multiple screen sizes without sacrificing performance or readability.
Designing a scalable component architecture that supports future content expansion and maintenance.
lessonsLearned: Improved responsive development techniques using mobile-first approach and breakpoint-driven design.
Strengthened understanding of reusable component architecture in React applications.
Gained practical experience building maintainable UIs with Tailwind CSS utility classes.
Learned to structure landing pages with clear information hierarchy optimized for user scanning patterns.

title: Landing Page DiikatJanji
description: Responsive landing page for DiikatJanji, a modern digital wedding invitation platform featuring RSVP management, countdown timers, galleries, maps integration, music players, and love story sections.

Interactive hero section with platform introduction
Feature showcase highlighting RSVP, countdown, gallery, maps, and music
Smooth scroll navigation with call-to-action elements

Creating reusable UI components that simplify future maintenance and feature expansion for the growing platform.

Strengthened understanding of component-based frontend architecture for scalable applications.
Learned to build marketing-focused landing pages with clear information hierarchy and conversion-oriented design.
Enhanced skills in designing user interfaces that balance aesthetics with usability.
